Commentary.Commentary: So, the target isn't a big one but we all know Pakistan nearly made a mess of it against the Lankans in the virtual quarter final. England will be aware of Pakistan's inconsistency and if at all they manage to sneak in a few early scalps, we could very well have a match on our hands. Who will be the first team to qualify for the finals? Join us shortly to find out...

Sarfraz Ahmed couldn't have asked for a better show. His bowlers bowled as a unit and never let the game slip away. The new ball bowlers set the tone and then the spinners came to fore to keep the lid on the scoring rate. Special mention to Hasan Ali who once again rose to the occasion and impressed one and all. His figures of 10-0-35-3 speaks volumes. The bowlers were equally backed by the fielders who took everything that came their way.

An exceptional display of bowling from Pakistan twice in two games have seen them restricting England to a really scanty total. They would be really elated today as they were without Amir but his replacement in the name of Raees didn't let them miss his duties. To be honest, England never really got going. Root was the only man who was looking in good nick but he too was sent packing.  All the Englishmen found it really tough to middle the ball and the fact that Stokes was struggling to score, tells you how beautifully the Asian team bowled.

OUT! Run out! England have been bowled out for 211! Short ball on middle, Jake Ball misses his attempted pull shot and blindly tries to steal a bye. Sarfraz collects the ball and has an underarm shy at the striker's end. He hits and Mark Wood was nowhere in the frame.

In the air... safe! Fuller in length on the stumps, Ball lofts it down the ground. Malik from long on comes across to his left and does well to keep the ball in play. They refer it upstairs to see if Malik made contact with the rope when he had the ball in his hand. He didn't and a couple is taken.
Another yorker outside off, Jake Ball jams it out. The ball goes straight to the man at backward point.
Yorker, close to the off stump line, Ball fails to dig it out.
Back of a length, outside off, Jake Ball shimmies down a touch to have a go at it but is beaten all ends up.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball to start the final over! Shortish on middle, Wood half-pulls it through backward square leg for a single. Junaid oversteps and will have to reload.
Junaid Khan to bowl the final over.
Slower one, it's the back of the hand delivery, Wood somehow gets some wood on it. The ball rolls towards the leg side for a single.
Jake Ball is the last man in!
OUT! Gone! Shortish ball, angling in. Liam Plunkett looks to pull but doesn't get enough behind the shot. The ball travels towards deep square leg where Azhar Ali takes a fine catch.

FOUR! Edged and that will help the hosts! A low full toss outside off, Plunkett makes room and then throws his bat at it. Gets an outside edge down to third man and picks up a much, much-needed boundary for his side.
Slower one again, outside off, Wood runs it down to third man for a single.
Yorker on the stumps, Wood keeps it out.
Slower delivery outside off, Wood is completely deceived by it.
Good length outside off, defended towards backward point. Hasan Ali ends with figures of - 10-0-35-3, brilliant!
Fuller outside off, driven towards cover.
Mark Wood walks in next!

OUT! Ben Stokes' struggling knock comes to an end! Hasan Ali once again changes the pace, hurls a length ball on leg, Ben Stokes once again gets trapped as he looks to go across the line. The ball lobs off the leading edge towards covers and Mohammad Hafeez settles safely under it. Exceptional from Ali as he now becomes the leading wicket-taker this year's Champions Trophy.
Good bowling! Slower one around middle and leg, Stokes moves leg side and is ages early into the slog. Misses it completely and a good take by Sarfraz by moving to his right.
Fuller at the base of the stumps, drilled down to long on for a single.

Fuller and tailing back in, Plunkett gets an inside edge towards fine leg. They look for the second as Rumman Raees has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, Plunkett would have been a goner.
Free Hit Time.
Very full on middle and leg, Stokes flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. Ali has overstepped and it's called as a no ball.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a single.
Wide! Doles out a short ball outside off, Stokes looks to go after it but is undone by the extra bounce. The umpire calls it a wide, Sarfraz shakes his head.
Makes room to this full ball but hits it straight to the man at extra cover.

A yorker on leg, Plunkett fails to dig it out as the ball goes off the pads towards the right of the keeper. Sarfraz has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been close. Leg bye taken.
Driven straight to the fielder at cover.
In the air... falls short! Back of a length on middle, Stokes mistimes his pull down to long on. The ball falls well short of the man running in. A single taken.

Keeps it nice and full on the stumps, Stokes clips it through mid-wicket. The long on fielder comes running to his left and the man from mid-wicket comes to his right. The former gets to the ball and parries it to the latter. Good tag team in the deep and they take a brace.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length delivery, a bit of width outside off, Plunkett looks to slash at it but gets an outside edge down to third man for a single.
A full toss, tailing back in a touch, Liam mistimes his punch back to the bowler who collects it with a leap to his left.
Fuller in length and angling in, Plunkett fails to get any bat on it and is hit on the pads.
Good length delivery on middle, Stokes looks to pull but gets it off the toe end of the bat towards deep mid-wicket. He wanted to come back for the second one but he slips at the bowler's end.
Very full on the stumps, Stokes makes room and jams it out towards cover.
Slower short ball outside off, dragged down to long on for a single. Another brilliant over.
A low full toss on leg, Stokes flicks it towards deep square leg and calls for two immediately. He gets it comfortably in the end.
Short ball, angling in, LP pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Comes from around the wicket, hurls a length ball on middle, defended towards the leg side by Liam.
Back of a length on off, Stokes flat-bats it to mid off for a single.
Back of a length ball, angling in on middle, pulled straight to mid-wicket.
Fuller ball on off, pushed off the front foot towards mid off.
Fuller on leg, whipped through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Stokes pushes it back to the bowler. It goes off Ali's boots towards the leg side but they don't take a single.
Liam Plunkett is the new man in!

OUT! Run out! England in dire straits now! But nothing to take away from Pakistan! Excellency at its best! Ali angles in a very full ball on middle, Rashid misses and is hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards covers but Hasan is busy appealing for an LBW. The umpire shakes his head and the batsmen look for a leg bye. In the meanwhile, Ahmed Shehzad (sub) charges towards the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end and he hits. They take it upstairs and replays find the English leggie short.
There is a run out appeal as Ahmed Shehzad (sub) scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. Rashid is the man in question. Pakistan are confident but umpire Rod Tucker refer it upstairs...
Angles in another short ball, Stokes pulls it along the ground through square leg for a single.
Short of a length ball on off, Stokes looks to pull but gets it off the toe end of the bat back to the bowler.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack!
Fuller outside off, slower in pace, Stokes mistimes his drive through point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, pulled straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball, it kicks off the deck, Stokes lets it be. Raees turns back and sees the umpire stretching both his hands, calling it a wide.
Slower one, gripping off the surface as Rashid looks to work it away. Gets it off something towards short third man and they cross over. The umpire signals it as a run.
Make it three in a row! On a length and pitched outside off, Rashid looks to run it down but once again fails to put bat on ball.
Marginally ahead of a length outside off, Rashid once again is beaten on the outside edge.
Good length delivery, from around the wicket, Rashid has a tentative poke inside the line and is beaten all ends up.
Rumman Raees is back into the attack. Imad Wasim slipped in the previous over and is seen walking off the field...
Stokes lunges forward and flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Sloppy! Stokes works this full ball towards square leg. The fielder there dives and takes a bit of time to stop it cleanly which allows the batsmen to come back for the second.
Quicker ball around leg, turning further down, Stokes clips it straight to short fine leg.
Outside off, driven a bit square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Flighted ball around middle, bunted back to the bowler who dives to his right to stop it. He doesn't do so cleanly but the man from short mid-wicket was quick to get to the ball.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Stokes knocks it down to long on for a single.
Fuller and angling in on middle and leg, clipped through long on for a single.
Shortish outside off, Stokes ducks to let it be. Lovely piece of bowling from Junaid this.
Good length delivery on middle, angling away a bit, Adil pushes it off the front foot towards covers for one.
Good length delivery outside off, Stokes flat-bats it down to long on for a single.
Hits the deck hard, gets a good amount of bounce, Stokes sways away from it.
Comes around the wicket and serves a full ball outside off, Rashid drives it off the front foot through covers for a single.
Powerplay 3 signalled. 5 fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Bowls a wrong one outside leg stump, Stokes tries to defend it off the front foot but is struck on the pads. Sarfraz appeals but the umpire is not interested. The ball must have pitched outside leg.
Fires it in full on the stumps, Stokes drives it to covers.
Tosses it up on off, Rashid works it with his wrist down to long on for a run.
Quicker on off, Rashid cuts it to point.
Bowls a leg spinner on off, Rashid guides it down through short third man for a couple.
Bowls it on the pads, Stokes flicks it through square leg for a run.
Shadab Khan is back into the attack.
Length ball on off, Rashid defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Punches the ball outside off, through covers for a couple.
Adil Rashid comes out to the middle.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Fakhar Zaman you beauty. That was amazing by the youngster. Moeen Ali has to go back now. Junaid digs in a short one on middle, Ali goes for a pull but gets a top edge down to deep backward square leg. Zaman makes great ground to his left, keeps his eye on the ball, stretches his hand out and takes a brilliant catch. Junaid Khan celebrates it in a unique way. England are losing their way further and they need a partnership here.
Lands it on a length on off, Ali defends it off the front foot.
Short ball outside off, Stokes cuts it through the off side for a run.
There are some words being exchanged between Imad Wasim and Ben Stokes.
Charges down the track and goes for the same shot but hits it straight to mid-wicket.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL SHOT! Flights it on the stumps, Moeen Ali flicks it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floats it on middle, Stokes uses his feet but does not quite time the shot. Hits it to long on for a run.
Flatter ball on off, Stokes pushes it off the back foot.
Drives the ball on off stump to long off for a run.
Tosses it on off, Ali comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Mohammad Hafeez is back into the attack.
Bowls a bouncer on middle, Ali pulls it deep square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Stokes hits it to covers who half-stops it and concedes a single.
Bowls a bouncer outside off, Stokes comes inside the line but lets it go through to the keeper.
Short ball on off, does not bounce that high, Stokes goes for the pull but gets it from the toe end of the bat to mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Stokes walks down the wicket and defends it on the off side.
Full ball tailing back in on off, Stokes drives it to mid off.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Ali does not play a shot.

FOUR! Uppish but safe. Bowls it wide outside off, Ali drives it square through point for a boundary. Zaman makes good ground to his right and dives but is not able to stop the ball. A lazy effort from him. Much-needed boundary for England.
Bowls it on a length, Ali defends it covering the line of the ball.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
LOVELY BOWLING! Bowls it on a length on off, the ball holds its line. Ali pokes at it and gets beaten. It also missed the off pole by a whisker.
BEATEN! Full ball outside off, Ali goes for a drive but gets beaten.
Bowls a short ball outside off, Stokes thinks about pulling it but then does not and lets it go through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length, Stokes plays it on the off side.
Hurls it on a length, Ben Stokes defends it off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Stokes lets the ball through to the keeper.
Full toss on leg, Moeen Ali flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Moeen Ali strides out to the middle.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. The dangerous Buttler has to depart. Junaid Khan bowls a lovely back of a length ball on middle which moves away off the deck. Buttler tries to push it inside the line but gets a faint outside edge to his opposite number. England are in trouble here. They have half their side back in the hut. Pakistan are all pumped and the crowd is ecstatic.
Drinks are on the field!
A tad fuller, Stokes drives it straight back to the bowler.
Drives the ball through mid off for a run.
Hurls it on middle, Stokes flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Lands it outside off, Ben Stokes lets it through to the keeper.
Angles it into the pads, Stokes flicks it to mid on.
Lands it on a length on off, Stokes defends it off the front foot.
Bowls it short outside off, Buttler goes for the pull but is beaten.
Angles it into the pads, Stokes flicks it through square leg for a run.
Slanting it across, Buttler punches it through the off side for a run.
SNORTER! Buttler comes down the track, Junaid sees him and bowls a very good bouncer on the stumps, Jos does well to duck under it.
Back of a length on off, Stokes pushes it through the off side for a run.
Bowls it on middle, Buttler flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Junaid Khan comes back into the attack. Root and Bairstow are seen wearing a disappointed smile on their faces in the dressing room. They know England are in a spot of bother here.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full outside off, Buttler drives it through covers for a run.
Jos Buttler comes out to bat.

OUT! HASAN ALI STRIKES! He has been brilliant throughout the tournament. He has always provided the breakthrough when Pakistan needed it. England are crumbling here. A length ball outside off, Morgan comes down the track and slashes at the ball. Gets an outside edge to Sarfraz. This was action replay of the way he got out against New Zealand. They all go up and the umpire gives it out. What a bowling change by the captain, Sarfraz. The in-form Morgan has to depart. Ali is now the joint highest wicket-taker in this year's tournament.
Walks down to a length delivery on off, the ball holds its line and takes the outside edge down to third man for a run.
Bowls it outside off, Morgan runs it down to third man for a run.
Back of a length on off, Morgan pushes it off the back foot to mid off.
Hasan Ali comes back into the attack.
Bowls it on the pads, Morgan works it on the leg side for a run.
Floats it on the stumps, Stokes drives it to long on for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tosses it up, Morgan comes down the track and drives it to long on for a run.
Flicks it to mid-wicket for no runs.

How has that missed the stumps? Hafeez drags his length back a little. Morgan goes back and tries to pull but misses. The ball just about kisses the leg pole and then deflects off the keeper's gloves towards short fine leg. The fielder catches and starts to appeal. The umpire nods his head. Replays show there was no wood involved.
Flatter one around middle and leg, flicked off the back foot past Imad Wasim at mid-wicket for a single.
Good work! A bit short outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover where Shadab dives to make a classy stop.
Fuller on middle, flicked towards Wasim at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Pitched around leg, Morgan reverse swept it over backward point to find a much-needed boundary.
Tossed up on the stumps, worked towards the leg side.
Around middle and leg, Stokes flicks it through mid-wicket. Imad Wasim fails to stop it and a single is taken.
Gives it a decent flight, Eoin bunts it back to the bowler again. Just a single from it! Good passage of play for Pakistan!
Tosses up around off, driven towards short extra cover.
Shortish around off, punched past the bowler for a single.
Punches it off the back foot back to the bowler.
Easy, easy bachche, shouts Sarfraz. It means - take it easy bloke! Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot towards short cover where Shadab Khan slips.
Flatter through the air around middle and off, Stokes pushes it back to the bowler.
Stokes is underway! Makes a bit of room and drives it through extra cover for a single. Just 2 and a big wicket of Root from it.
Wrong 'un around leg, turning in as Stokes covers the line to defend it down.
A short leg and a slip in place. Pakistan on the attack, screams an excited Ramiz Raja on air.
Around middle and leg, worked with soft hands towards the leg side.
Ben Stokes, the centurion in their last game, walks in next!

OUT! Extra bounce does Root in! Shadab Khan gets the big fish here! Bowls a loopy leg break outside off and it turns away with a bit of extra bounce. Root looks to cut it through the line but gets a feather to it. Sarfraz behind the stumps gobbles a sharp catch and goes up almost instantly. They keep appealing and this time umpire Rod Tucker raises his finger. Root walks back dejected as he misses out on his half century. A vital 48-run stand comes to an end.
Fuller one around middle, worked towards square leg for a single.
Comes dancing down the track and looks to flick. But misses and is hit on the pads.
Nicely done! Slower one around off, Root walks across the sticks and paddles it down to fine leg. Collects two.
Stays rooted inside the crease but whips it straight to the man at square leg.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Stays back and looks to hit it down the ground. Hafeez does well to stop it.
Comes down the track and works it towards mid-wicket for nothing.
Turning in from around off, clipped through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! That's drilled! Morgan spoils the over for the leggie. A googly but it's a bit overpitched, Morgan makes room and drills it through extra cover to end the over with a boundary.
Sits back and punches it back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! The decision is overturned! Another successful review from England! Tossed up around middle and off, a bit of extra bounce as well. Morgan gets into the position to play the reverse sweep but the ball lobs off something to Babar Azam at first slip who takes the catch. They appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Morgan is confident and he takes the review as he suggests that it has gone off the forearm. Replays show the English skipper is right. However, they now check for the LBW - pitched in line but would have gone over the stumps. Eoin survives a scare here.
Eoin Morgan is given out caught at slip. He feels that it has hit his arm. The English skipper opts for the review...
Eases one down to long on and takes a single.
Full again, flicked towards mid-wicket where Hafeez makes a diving stop.
Pakad says Sarfraz! It means field yourself! Tossed up around middle, Root looks to flick but gets a leading edge back to the bowler who dives to his left and stops it on the bounce.

There's a slight delay here. Joe Root is seen having some tablets. He is having a word with the physio. And much to everyone's surprise the towels are out which is used by the players to wipe off their sweat. Have seen this after a very long time in England. All set, Shadab Khan to continue with a slip in place...
Floats it up on middle and leg, flicked past mid on for a single.
Darts it around the pads, clipped through the leg side for a single.
Back to fuller length around off, driven off the front foot towards cover.
FOUR! Hit that hard! Hafeez drags his length back a touch but it's enough for Morgan to make him pay. Eoin camps back and pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket leg for a boundary.
Quicker one outside off, punched to extra cover where the fielder made a diving stop.
Flatter through the air, stays a touch low, clipped through square leg for a single.
Change of ends for Mohammad Hafeez!
Morgan prods forward to this tossed up delivery and nudges it towards mid-wicket. Just 3 from the over!
Keeps it full again outside off, Root shows a straight bat as the ball rolls down to long off for a single.
Down the leg side, helped behind square on the leg side. A single picked up.
Flighted ball on middle and leg, Morgan leans forward and works it straight to short mid-wicket.
A slip is brought in for Morgan.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Joe leans into it and drives it through the gap at covers for just a single.
A bit short, turning away from outside off, punched off the back foot towards point.
Shadab Khan is called back into the attack!
Fuller and angling in on middle, wristed through mid-wicket for a single.
Changes the pace, a bit full on middle and leg, Eoin drives it down to long on for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! Chance goes down! Short and angling down leg, from around the wicket. Morgan is hurried with that one as he looks to pull it away. The ball goes off the gloves and rolls past Sarfraz who dives to his right but couldn't do anything about it. A boundary for Morgan but certainly wouldn't impress him.
Fuller in length, driven past covers for a single.
Quicker one, coming in, Morgan once again cuts it late towards point.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
A bit short, on middle and leg, flicked towards deep mid-wicket. They wanted another one but Ali in the deep doesn't allow. 100 up for England!
Root lunges forward to this tossed up ball and hits it down to long on. Another single taken.
Nicely slows it through the air after seeing Morgan coming down the track, the English skipper flicks it towards long on for a single.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, driven down to long on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Morgan is desperate to step out and attempt a big stroke. Ends up getting a bottom edge towards the cover fielder. Another tidy over from Hasan!
Taps it down to point for a sharp single.
Leans forward and drives it on the up through covers. Gets a single this time.
Good length delivery, served in the channel on off, Morgan defends it near the pitch.
Comes around the wicket now, hurls a full ball on middle and leg, Morgan jams it out to mid on.
Fuller in length and around off, tapped in front of cover-point for a single. There was a shy made at the bowler's end but it missed the stumps.
Punched off the back foot through extra cover for a couple.
Sits back and looks to cut. He does so eventually but was a risky stroke to play against Hafeez.

A loud, loud shout for LBW! Quicker one around middle and off, Morgan looks to reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. Hafeez and Sarfraz start to appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show, it's a good call from the umpire as there was an inside edge.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Slower through the air, landed too full, Morgan milks it down to long on to get to the other end.
Tosses it around off, Morgan eases it towards mid off.

Good stop, Malik! A bit fuller and just outside off, Root looks to drive it on the up but gets it off the outer half of the bat down to third man. Malik in the deep comes running to his right, dives, fumbles a bit but still manages to keep them down to a couple.
Stays behind to this length delivery and taps it towards the off side.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball on middle, Root looks to pull but then doesn't go on with the shot as the ball was too high.
Sprays it a bit wide outside off, glided through backward point for a single.
Short and close to off stump, Morgan crouches low and chops it towards backward point.
Slants it on a length outside off, Morgan shoulders his arms.
Fuller in length on off, driven through covers for a single.

No bowler would like it. Hasan Ali comes steaming in and just when he was about to deliver, Root pulls out and Ali will have to go back. The fielder from point was moving around which distracted Root.
Keeps it full around off, Morgan makes room and bunts it straight back to the bowler who dives to his right to stop it.
Presses forward to this full ball and defends it gently on the ground.
Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Morgan defends it off the back foot.
Flatter one around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Drops it a bit short, it stays a bit low, pulled down to long on for a single. The English skipper is off the mark.
A slip in place.
Starts off with a flatter ball around off, punched to deep point for a single.
Mohammad Hafeez is brought into the attack now. This is a good move from Sarfraz.
Back of a length on middle, Morgan punches it back to Hasan Ali. A superb over from him to begin with.
On a length and closer to the off stump line, Root comes forward, taps it in front of covers for a quick single.
Good length on middle and leg, clipped from the crease to mid on.
Drinks are on the field! Also, Eoin Morgan strides out to the middle.

OUT! In the air... gone! Hasan Ali strikes in his very first over. And then the celebration - both the arms aloft and then punches downwards. A short ball, angling in, Bairstow looks to pull but doesn't get enough meat behind the shot. It goes straight to Hafeez at deep square leg who makes no mistake. Bairstow is really disappointed to have thrown it away, after getting two lives.
Jonny looks to flat bat it down the ground but hits it straight to mid on.
Good length delivery on middle, Bairstow defends it back down the wicket.
Hasan Ali into the attack now!

Dropped again! There was a slip placed for that and Babar Azam has spilled one. Nicely tossed up around off, Bairstow looks to drive without any foot movement and gets an outside edge. Azam at first slip fails to hold on to that one and Hasan Ali from short third man comes running in to take it but the ball falls short of him. Sarfraz can't believe it. But give it up to his captaincy. Bairstow gets another reprieve.
Drops it a bit short outside off, Bairstow cuts it hard but finds the man at short third man.
A slip in place.
Floats it up around off, pushed towards point off the front foot.
Loopy low full toss on middle, Root sweeps it cleanly towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Short and turning away around off, Root punches it off the back foot towards covers.
Very full around off, jammed down to long on for a single.
Darts it in on the stump, Bairstow drives it through mid off for a run.
Bowls it full on off, Root drives it through covers for a run.
Slower through the air, Root looks to drive it but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Fires it in on the stumps, Bairstow drives it down to long on for a run.
Drags his length back a little outside off, Bairstow cuts it to point.
Root drives it through long on for a run.
Bowls it short, Bairstow guides it to short third man.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
BEAUTY! Tosses it outside off, Bairstow leans forward and goes to drive but the ball turns and beats him. The leg spinner got some turn and bounce there.
Tosses it outside off, Root drives it through covers for a run.
Almost the action replay of the last ball but does not get it as straight as he would have liked. The ball goes on the bounce to Shoaib Malik down at long on. They run a single.
FOUR! BRUTE FORCE! Shadab tosses it up on off, Bairstow flat bats it straight back past the bowler for a boundary. That was hit with a lot of power.
Angles it into the batsman, the batsman drives it down to long on for a run.
Slower through the air, Jonny pushes it straight back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Bairstow cuts it straight to point.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Fires it in on the stumps, Bairstow drives it back to the bowler.
Bowls it on middle, Root drives it to long on for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Low full toss outside off, Root drives it to covers. Will be disappointed he could not get that away.
Quicker outside off, Root goes to cut but misses it.
FOUR! POOR LENGTH! Drags it short on the stumps, Root has ample time and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Not a good follow up delivery, short outside off, Bairstow cuts it through covers for a run.
Almost gets a wicket off his first ball. Bowls a leg spinner on off, Root goes to flick it but gets a leading edge just to the right of the cover fielder. The ball goes down to long off for a run.
Shadab Khan is brought into the attack.
Bowls it on the pads, Root flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Darts it in on the stumps, Bairstow punches it off the back foot down to long off for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fires it on the stump, Bairstow punches it past the diving extra cover fielder for a run.
Angles it into the pads, Root flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls it full on the pads, Bairstow flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of four fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Stays behind and runs it down to third man for a single.

Dropped! But it would be harsh to call it one. Back of a length delivery on middle, Bairstow stays put and looks to pull. Gets it off the toe end of the bat towards mid-wicket where Azhar Ali leaps and tries to catch it but the ball doesn't stick. It pops out and goes behind. Had he held on to that one, it would have been a spectacular catch. A single taken but what an effort from Ali nonetheless.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Root looks to punch but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls behind square on the leg side for one.
Shortish and served a bit wide outside off, cut through point for a brace.
Slower one on the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Darts it on the stumps, Root tries to push it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Appeal for LBW, but is not given. Bowls an arm ball angling in. Root goes back and tries to flick it but misses and the ball strikes his pads. Pakistan appeal but the ball might be missing leg.
Bowls it on the stumps, Root defends it off the back foot.
Drives it down the ground to long off for a run.
Bairstow comes down the track, Wasim sees him coming and bowls it short on his pads. Bairstow goes for the flick but misses it and strikes his pads.
Fires it on the stumps, Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Bowls it on the pads, Root flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball on middle, Root defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on middle, Bairstow flicks it through square leg for a run.
Back of a length around off, Bairstow cuts it behind point for a couple.
Angles it away on a length, Bairstow defends it off the front foot.
Bowls it on the stumps, Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
Flattish and a bit of width outside off, Root cuts it behind point and comes back for a couple. The English run-machine is off the mark.
Root skips down the track and clips it towards the on side. Babar Azam at mid-wicket dives way before but luckily the ball comes in the same direction and he is able to stop that.
Flat and quicker one on middle, skidding off the deck, Root just about manages to get his bat down and keep it out.
Floats it up outside off, pushed off the front foot towards the cover fielder.
Quicker one around middle and off, skidding through as Root hangs back to clip it away.
Starts off with a full ball around middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Time for spin then. Imad Wasim to roll his arm over...
Bowls it wide of off, Root tries to put bat on it but misses.
Joe Root is the next man in.

OUT! The debutant strikes. That would settle his nerves. He nearly got him in the previous over but the review saved him, but there is no doubt this time. Bowls it on a fuller length on middle, Hales comes down the track and tries to go inside-out. Does not get the elevation he wanted and hits it straight to covers where Babar Azam takes a simple catch. Hales has to depart. Pakistan get their first wicket. Rumman has a big smile on his face.
Strays it on the pads, Bairstow flicks it to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! LOVELY TIMING! Lands it on a length on off, Bairstow pushes it straight back past the bowler for a boundary. The fielder at mid off does try to dive and stop it but fails to do so.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lands it on a length outside off, Bairstow goes for the cut but misses it.
FOUR! That is a throwdown. Slower ball and it is very full. Hales just hits it through covers for a boundary.
Shortish ball on off, Bairstow punches it to mid off for a run.
Junaid bowls it on a length, gets some extra bounce. Bairstow checks his shot and goes uppishly but falls short of covers. Fakhar Zaman has a shy at the non-striker's end but does not hit.
Full ball on off, Bairstow drives it to mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Bowls it on a length on off, Bairstow gets an outside edge to covers.

NOT OUT! It is all going England's way. Rumman Raees bowls it on a length it shapes in a little. Hales loos to play it with a straight bat but misses and is struck on the pads. Pakistani players go up and the umpire gives it this time. Hales and Bairstow have a long chat in the middle and Hales finally decides to review it. There is no inside edge on it. But the ball is just pitching outside leg. OH MY! That was the only thing which could have saved him. A successful review for England. Mickey Arthur the Pakistan coach cannot believe it.
Alex Hales has been given out LBW. He goes for a review. Looks out to the naked eye. Only pitching can be a concern.
Strays on the pads, Hales flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Drifts it on the pads, Bairstow flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Bowls it on the leg stump, Bairstow goes for the flick but misses and is struck high on the pads. There is a half appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Maybe pitching outside leg.
Bowls it outside off, Hales guides it down to third man for a run.
Length ball outside off, Hales tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Lands it on length on off, Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length, Bairstow tries to flick but gets it off the inner edge through mid-wicket for a couple.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Length ball on middle, Bairstow pulls it over the square leg fielder for a boundary. After a nervy start he is underway now.
FOUR! Bowls it on the pads, Bairstow clips it through square leg for a boundary. That should get him going.
Bowls it on middle, Bairstow tickles it fine for a couple.
Hurls it on a length on off, Hales plays it behind point for a run. Shadab Khan at point makes a halfstop diving to his left.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Bairstow goes to cut but is beaten. Good first over by Raees.
Length ball angling across, Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
Lands it on a length, Hales comes down the wicket and slaps it to covers. Hafeez dives to his right and makes a very good stop. They run a single.
A tad fuller on off, Hales drives it to mid off.
Back of a length ball, Hales plays it off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Bairstow plays it on the off side for a run.
Rumman Raees will bowl with the second new ball.
FOUR! Full ball on off, Hales leans into the drive and drives it past mid off for a boundary. Hales hits the first boundary of the day. What an eventful over.
Hurls it on a length on off, Hales tries to push it on the offside but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length on off, Hales punches it to mid off off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length on off, Bairstow tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the leg side for a run.

NOT OUT! Bairstow survives. That was so close. Junaid bowls it on a length, Bairstow looks to work with a straight bat but misses it and is struck on the pads. Pakistan players go up for an appeal and the umpire gives it not out. The bowler wants to review it and Sarfraz Ahmed does take the review. There was no bat involved. It pitched in line, struck him in line but just clipping the off stump. So the on-field call remains. Pakistan lose their only review in the very first over.
Drama straightaway! Pakistan have taken a review for LBW against Jonny Bairstow. Has it pitched outside leg? TV umpire is asked for some assistance...
Starts off with a yorker. Bairstow does well to dig it out. Good start by Junaid Khan.

The national anthems are done and dusted. The players are making their way out to the middle. The English openers are ALEX HALES and JONNY BAIRSTOW. Pakistan to begin with JUNAID KHAN first up. A couple of slips in place. Here we go!!!
The players and the umpires are out for their respective national anthem.

PITCH REPORT - Ricky Ponting doing the pitch report says that there is a tinge of green on the surface. Adds it's nice and hard and feels the average score here is 261. Mentions that the outfield is quick. Feels the bowlers might rely more on the cross-seam deliveries.

EOIN MORGAN says he would have batted first anyway even if they had won the toss. Adds the wicket looks good as compared to the last game. Lauds the groundsmen for doing a fantastic job. Further says Pakistan are a dangerous unit and can beat any side if it's their day. Informs they have made one change - JONNY BAIRSTOW replaces Jason Roy.

SARFRAZ AHMED says they will bowl first. He feels it looks like a good batting wicket and he hopes it does not change later. He informs Mohammad Amir will not be playing due to back spasm, RUMMAN RAEES will be making his ODI debut and SHADAB KHAN comes in for Fahim Ashraf. Reckons if they can play positive cricket against a good team then they can beat them.
TOSS - The captains are out for the toss. Eoin Morgan flips the coin. Tails is the call from Sarfraz Ahmed. It comes down as a Tail. PAKISTAN WILL BOWL FIRST!

Pakistan and their unpredictable nature have gone hand in hand. Losing to India by a heavy margin and then winning back-to-back games have seen them booking a berth in the knockouts. Come this day, they would be hoping to tick all the boxes and don't be surprised if they manage to throw another surprise. We are hearing that their frontline bowler, Mohammad Amir might miss out today due to back spasm but let's wait for the confirmation. Given it's a do-or-die for either side we are expecting a cracking contest. Stay tuned as the all-important toss isn't far away.

The league stage is done and dusted and it's now time for the first semifinal to get underway. England and Pakistan will lock horns in Cardiff today and first and foremost, the sun is out and that should please all the cricketing fans across the world. The hosts have been in sublime form, being unbeaten in the tournament and are the only team to do so. Their only worry is opener's, Jason Roy's lean patch and in all likelihood it might be Jonny Bairstow replacing him at the top. Apart from that, they should be going in with the same team.
